name: @demo/backend-token-client
description: Vite + React backend-token auth demo for the orpc-ws-library e2e suite. Server holds the refresh token; the browser pulls a short-lived access token and passes it via the WS `?token=`. Imports ONLY @orpc-ws/client + @orpc-ws/react (no oidc packages) to prove the WS-only consumer path. Runs standalone (dev: vite on 5174, e2e: vite preview on 4174).
